jobs.title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
jobs.description:
Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Tu es probablement :

  • un·e coach agile aguerri au passé de dev, ayant une approche hands-on

  • un·e Product Ops senior ;

  • ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ;

Et surtout :

  • Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

  • Tu sais analyser un flux de valeur de développement, repérer les goulots d’étranglement, et transformer une friction en dispositif concret.

  • Tu utilises déjà l’IA au quotidien dans ta pratique professionnelle (claude code, cursor, …).

  • Tu sais tirer parti de copilotes, assistants, outils d’automatisation, outils de documentation augmentée et solutions d’orchestration légère.

  • Tu es capable de builder toi-même des agents ou assistants simples, sans prétendre être la personne qui les industrialisera techniquement à grande échelle.

  • Tu sais passer de l’idée à l’outil, puis de l’outil à l’adoption.

  • Tu es à l’aise aussi bien avec des équipes opérationnelles qu’avec des interlocuteurs de direction.

  • Tu as suffisamment de culture produit pour ne pas confondre vitesse et valeur.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment.

Ton savoir-être

  • Tu es énergique, pragmatique et orienté impact.

  • Tu aimes autant transformer un mode de fonctionnement que mettre les mains dans les outils.

  • Tu sais embarquer sans évangéliser dans le vide.

  • Tu as une posture de partenaire exigeant : direct, utile, crédible.

  • Tu navigues bien entre technique, produit, organisation et business.

  • Tu sais faire avancer un sujet même quand tout n’est pas encore cadré.

Et en interne, au sein de Thiga

  • Tu interviens comme consultant·e en mission, au plus près des enjeux clients.

  • Tu contribues au développement de l’offre AI Product Ops / POM-AI avec le référent de l’offre.

  • Tu participes à la production de contenu, à la capitalisation, au partage interne et à certaines démarches d’avant-vente.

  • Tu contribues à faire monter Thiga en niveau sur les nouvelles pratiques d’organisation produit à l’ère de l’IA.

Les étapes 🎢
 
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.
  • Une rencontre avec un des Directeurs de la Tribe Conseil
  • Une étude de cas afin de confirmer ce que vous savez mettre en pratique.
  • Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝
Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.title: Freelance Product Designers
jobs.description:
Thiga cherche des freelances pour intervenir sur des missions à fort impact
Tu es Product Designer, et tu ne te contentes pas de designer des écrans mais de construire des produits performants ?
Tu t’appuies sur la data, comprends les enjeux business, et utilises l’IA pour aller plus vite et plus loin ?
Tu es au bon endroit.

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que le Design est un accélérateur de croissance responsable pour les entreprises.
Mais pour avoir un réel impact, le rôle du designer doit évoluer.
Nous défendons une approche de Product Designers “Product Builders”, capables de maîtriser l’ensemble du cycle produit : de la discovery à la delivery, en collaboration étroite avec le Produit, la Tech et le Business.

Des designers augmentés par la data et l’IA, qui leur permettent d’explorer plus vite, décider avec justesse et délivrer avec impact.
En plaçant les besoins réels des utilisateurs au cœur des produits, tout en intégrant les enjeux économiques, sociaux et environnementaux, le design devient un levier puissant pour une innovation à la fois performante et durable.

Le Product Design doit donc être porté à un niveau stratégique pour transformer réellement les organisations.

Nous recherchons des freelances qui incarnent cette vision.

jobs.title: Data Product Manager H/F
jobs.description:
En tant que Data Product Manager, tu seras en immersion au sein des équipes de nos clients.

Tu travailleras pour des sociétés allant de la startup française au grand groupe international, dans des secteurs aussi divers que les transports, l’assurance, le luxe, la musique, le tourisme ou encore la banque en ligne.

Que ce soit pour identifier et cadrer les cas d’usage pertinents pour lancer un nouveau Produit Data ou pour accompagner le développement au sein d’une équipe de Data Scientists et Data Engineers, nos Data PM sont là pour apporter une vision et une démarche produit sur des sujets de pointe !  


 

Ta mission au quotidien :
  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins utilisateurs et business du client
  • Définir la stratégie et roadmap du produit.
  • Etablir une vision produit “claire” identifier les incertitudes et mettre en place les démarches pertinentes pour les lever
  • Savoir définir le MVP d’un Produit Data et les itérations qui permettront d’atteindre la vision 
  • Analyser les performances techniques et métier du produit, identifier les leviers d’amélioration et animer la co-création de solutions pertinentes
  • Déterminer, rédiger et prioriser les fonctionnalités du produit sous forme d’Epics et d’User Stories avec les équipes métiers, business et technique.
  • Créer et s’assurer de la bonne tenue de ton backlog.
  • Suivre les différentes cérémonies agiles comme : le sprint planning, les daily meetings, des rétrospectives, des démonstrations au client.
  • Collaborer avec l’UX Designer pour concevoir l'expérience utilisateur.
  • Participer à la mise en place de tests utilisateurs et en analyser les retours.
  • Maintenir la roadmap à court et moyen termes en prenant en compte les impacts business et les contraintes de développement.
  • Communiquer auprès de l’ensemble des parties prenantes.

    • Ton profil :
  • Tu as une très bonne culture Data Science : tu en connais les champs d’application, tu comprends les mécanismes et tu connais les enjeux de la création de Produit basé sur un modèle de Machine Learning 
  • Tu fais parfaitement la différence entre Culture Projet et Culture Produit.
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance théorique des pratiques agiles (méthodo Scrum & Kanban entre autres).
  • Les méthodes de création de produits numériques tels que le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup, n’ont plus de secret pour toi !
  • Tu es capable d’identifier, prioriser les besoins utilisateurs, communiquer des idées et être force de proposition.
  • Tu sais adopter le bon niveau de discours pour aligner des équipes très techniques et métier sur une vision et un objectif commun.

    • **LES petits (GROS) PLUS :**
  • Tu as des notions de Python et/ou Spark
  • Tu sais te servir d’un Notebook 
  • Tu as déjà suivi un MOOC comme celui d’Andrew Ng pour comprendre en profondeur comment le Machine Learning fonctionne

Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As a Senior Product Designer in Airalo’s User Experience division, you will shape consumer product experiences across native mobile and web for millions of people around the world. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on leading design from problem framing through delivery, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the Airalo Product Design Guild - our community for craft, critique, design systems, research-led decision-making, accessibility, experimentation, AI, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Lead end-to-end product design for Airalo’s consumer mobile and web experiences, from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, Growth, and other designers to translate customer needs, insights, and strategy into high-quality product improvements.
  • Create user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, UX copy, and production-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and stakeholder conversations that create alignment and momentum.
  • Contribute to Airalo’s Design System, improving consistency, accessibility, quality, and efficiency across products.
  • Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, critique, and shared practice.
  • Help strengthen the Product Design Guild by raising the bar for craft, collaboration, research-led decision-making, and thoughtful use of AI.

    • Must-haves:
  • 6+ years or similar of dedicated experience in product design at a tech startup, scale-up, product-led company, or product-focused agency.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality UI, thoughtful interaction design, strong product thinking, and measurable impact.
  • Extensive experience designing, testing, and shipping native mobile and web applications for B2C products.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous design problems from discovery through delivery, balancing user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and product strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Figma and FigJam skills, with experience creating flows, prototypes, product specifications, and production-ready design assets.
  • Advanced experience working with design systems, native mobile guidelines, responsive design, accessibility, and product quality across mobile and web.
  • Advanced experience with motion, prototyping, or interaction details that bring product experiences to life.
  • Experience working in Lean and/or Agile product development environments, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Data, and Growth.
  • Able to facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Experience using AI and emerging tools to improve the design workflow beyond simple prototyping.

    • Good to have:
  • Experience in telecommunications, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or global consumer products.
  • Knowledge of eSIMs, GSMA-related technologies, or mobile connectivity services.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Research, Data, Growth, or Content Design teams.

    • You should apply if…
  • You lead through craft, clarity, and systems thinking. You can turn complex problems into simple, well-crafted experiences while considering journeys, patterns, accessibility, content, edge cases, and scale.
  • You can own ambiguous problems. You do not need every answer before you start. You ask good questions, define the path forward, make smart trade-offs, and keep momentum without waiting to be told what to do.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You use research, data, customer feedback, and product strategy to make decisions that improve the user experience and support business goals.
  • You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.
  • You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.
  • You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

    • This isn't for you if…
  • You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.
  • You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.

  • You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive, EMEA (100% hunting role)
jobs.description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.


Our role in detail:

Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across prospect accounts.

  • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:

      • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

      • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

      • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

      • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

      • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

      • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

      • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

        • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

        Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

        You will:

        • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

        • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

        • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

        • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

        • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

        • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

        • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

          • Role Outcomes:

          Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned territory.

          You will be expected to:

          • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

          • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

          • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

          • Win strategically important competitive displacement opportunities.

          • Establish relationships with senior technology and security decision-makers across priority accounts.

          • Increase Sonatype's presence within major enterprise organisations.

          • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.

          • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel partners.

          • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

            • What Success Looks Like:

            First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

            You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

            You will assess your assigned territory, identify priority accounts, evaluate competitive incumbents and develop relationships with the wider Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel teams.

            You will begin building an evidence-based view of where the strongest new-logo opportunities exist.

            First 60 Days — Build the Acquisition Strategy

            You will be actively building relationships with prospective customers, generating qualified pipeline and coordinating account-based activity with the wider go-to-market organisation.

            Your opportunities will reflect clear customer challenges, credible buying processes and measurable business value.

            First 90 Days — Demonstrate Commercial Momentum

            You will be independently driving enterprise pursuits, demonstrating meaningful self-generated pipeline creation and establishing relationships with key decision-makers.

            You will be progressing opportunities through technical validation, commercial discovery and structured enterprise qualification.

            Your territory plan, pipeline coverage and forecasting will provide leadership with confidence in your approach to delivering against quota.

            First 12 Months — Deliver High Performance

            You will have established a sustainable enterprise acquisition engine and demonstrated the ability to deliver against a quota circa $1.5-2m.

            You will have acquired new enterprise customers, progressed competitive displacement opportunities and built a strong forward-looking pipeline.

            You will be recognised for your commercial judgement, proactive hunting mentality, enterprise customer credibility and ability to win complex opportunities.

            Who You Are:

            You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

            You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

            Essential Experience & Capabilities

            Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

            • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

            • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

            • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

            • Ability to quantify pipeline creation, average contract values, competitive wins and revenue performance.

              • Consistent High Performance

              • A history of operating among the strongest performers within your sales organisation.

              • President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition is particularly attractive.

              • Evidence of sustained performance across multiple sales periods, rather than reliance on one exceptional transaction or favourable territory.

                • Competitive Enterprise Selling

                • Proven experience winning business against established technology providers.

                • Ability to develop differentiated competitive strategies and challenge incumbent solutions.

                • Strong negotiation, executive engagement and commercial deal leadership skills.

                  • Enterprise Territory Development

                  • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                  • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                  • Ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying predominantly on inbound demand.

                    • Technical & Industry Understanding

                    • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

                    • Confidence engaging technical and executive stakeholders in complex buying environments.

                    • Ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

                      • Sales Methodology & Commercial Discipline

                      • Experience applying structured enterprise qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

                      • Strong forecasting, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.

                      • Ability to manage complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations and procurement processes.

                        • Preferred Experience:

                        We would particularly welcome candidates with experience from:

                        • Software supply chain security and software composition analysis.

                        • Application security and DevSecOps platforms.

                        • Repository management and developer infrastructure.

                        • Enterprise cybersecurity and cloud-native security.

                        • Enterprise platform selling and competitive displacement.

                        • Global 2000, Fortune 500 or similarly complex enterprise customers.

                        • Working with channel partners and enterprise systems integrators.

                        • Selling across the technology and enterprise ecosystem.

                        • Consumption-based, platform-led or land-and-expand commercial models.

jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 120+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 9 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

You keep the office running and make sure Wingtra stays a great place to work. Your days mix administrative work, office management and event organizing. You bring an organized, hands-on approach, look after the ambiance, the goodies and the events, and get the chance to keep improving them. You're also the first point of contact for Wingtranauts and business partners on anything to do with administration and the office.


Responsibilities
  • Answer the everyday questions. You handle basic inquiries from team members on behalf of Wingtra, like office and IT equipment and mail, so people get a quick answer from someone who knows.
  • Keep the paperwork moving. You open the mail, scan invoices and upload them to the right folder. You also check receipts.
  • Run the office basics. You order food and materials and look after the ambiance and the goodies. You're free to improve how it all works.
  • Welcome new Wingtranauts. You support onboarding and offboarding: handing out office keys, setting up the workstation and preparing merch for new starters.
  • Look after the merch. You manage the stock of internal and external merch products.
  • Bring people together. You support company-wide events and initiatives and liaise with colleagues abroad.
  • Organize external events. You plan two to three events a year.
  • Support the team day to day. You help Wingtranauts with administrative and logistic work as it comes up.
  • Grow into more. If performance and time allow, you take on more advanced tasks and complex projects.

    • Requirements
  • You have 1-2 years of experience in administrative work, office management and/or event management.
  • You're in the office at least three days a week, Friday afternoon is a must.
  • You're business fluent in English and German.
  • You're reliable, well-organized and diligent, and you follow processes and instructions with care.
  • You take responsibility and spot what needs doing, from a tidy office to a missing supply, so everyone has a good place to work.
  • You're comfortable with IT tools.
  • You enjoy steady contact with Wingtranauts and business partners, and you bring a positive, get-things-done attitude

    • We offer
  • Young and dynamic team
  • Party time job (40 to 50%) with flexible working hours
  • Gaining experience and personal development in an innovative company
  • Free snacks, a ping-pong table and lots of enthusiastic Wingtranauts ;-)
    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive scale-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Mechatronic Design & Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor.

We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test.




Responsibilities

  • Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured.

  • Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable.

  • Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline.

  • Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield.

  • Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain.


    • Requirements

  • You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines.

  • You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun.

  • AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team.

  • You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use.

    • You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA.

    If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Autonomy team who really enjoys creating quality, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through design improvements, and prioritizing sound interfaces and architecture. We are not specifically looking for roboticists, but welcome any person with extensive production software experience who wants to work in a real-world robotics deployment. At our company, we specialise in developing tailored software solutions that enable our robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. 

This is a senior, hands-on software engineering role at the heart of cutting‑edge R&D, mission frameworks, autonomous behaviors, obstacle avoidance, path planning and the application of modern AI techniques. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

 

Your Contributions
  • Contribute to the technical strategy and design for the autonomy software architecture, ensuring robots act transparently and reliably in complex environments
  • Lead and develop core robotics algorithms to expand our autonomous operational envelope in challenging conditions
  • Triage customer issues, recognize trends, and rapidly make our system more resilient to failures observed in the field.
  • Write, deploy, and maintain highly efficient C++ and Python software for the autonomy stack
  • Serve as a mentor and collaborator, participating in architecture group activities and guiding junior engineers on algorithm design and best practices
  • Evaluate cutting-edge algorithms and solutions to continuously push the boundaries of autonomous performance and system adaptability

    • Your Profile
  • University degree in engineering or science with a focus on computer science, electrical engineering or robotics
  • Proven track record of shipping software to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Proven experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • Strong contributor to technical strategy and mentoring of junior engineers
  • Strong understanding of autonomous systems, including: motion planning, state estimation, behaviour‑based control, path planning, mission planning & execution
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems, middleware frameworks and interfacing complex modules up and down the software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, working towards a goal and achieving outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Hands-on experience with Reinforcement Learning (RL) and deployment of cutting-edge AI/ML models
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures with task execution frameworks such as Behavior Trees
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Successfully managed strategic partnerships with external engineering companies
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
jobs.description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. 

  • Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. 

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. 

  • Experience contributing to design systems at scale. 

What we offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team

We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.


At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Software Platform & Middleware (Early Career)
jobs.description:
Build the Software Platform Powering Next-Generation Mobility

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.


What You’ll Do
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida
  • Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure
  • Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack
  • Assist in debugging and resolving complex software and system-level issues
  • Develop automated tests, CI workflows, and engineering tooling
  • Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development
  • Contribute ideas and improvements to developer workflows and platform usability

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals
  • Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work
  • Familiarity with Python or scripting languages
  • Experience developing software on Linux-based systems
  • Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

Nice to Have
  • Exposure to middleware or communication technologies such as ROS/ROS 2, DDS, shared memory IPC, or networking APIs
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing
  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects
  • Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems
  • Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles
  • Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms

Why Apex.AI
  • Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems
  • Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems
  • Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure
  • Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities
  • International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

Daarnaast bestaat een groot deel van je werk ook uit het uitvoeren van onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan de installaties volgens het onderhoudsplan. Onze fabrieken staan boordevol met techniek, o.a. sensoren, schakelkasten, relais, i/o kaarten, voedingen, omvormers en verdeelkasten, dus met jouw uitgebreide kennis, ga je bij ons veel plezier beleven. - Jij weet alles van elektromotoren, - frequentieregelaars en sensoren.- Je hebt een probleemoplossend vermogen- Je bent stressbestendig en kan effectief blijven presteren onder tijdsdruk, bij tegenslag, teleurstelling of tegenspel- Je voelt je prettig bij veilig werken.- Je hebt affiniteit met productieprocessen.- Je hebt een verbetermentaliteit en gaat voor een goed resultaat.Werken bij MBI betekent onderdeel zijn van een hecht familiebedrijf waar sfeer, samenwerking en werkplezier centraal staan. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en professioneel team van enthousiaste monteurs, waar iedereen voor elkaar klaarstaat.Binnen MBI is er veel aandacht voor veiligheid, gezondheid en een prettige werkomgeving. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is informeel en jouw mening telt écht. Leidinggevenden luisteren naar je ideeën en moedigen je aan om initiatief te nemen, bijvoorbeeld door actief mee te denken en bij te dragen aan verbeterprojecten. MBI is een familiebedrijf dat bestaat sinds 1945. Dankzij de passie en het vakmanschap van onze Steenmeesters groeien we nog steeds. Door deze passie onderscheiden wij ons met kwalitatief hoogwaardige producten en de kracht om klanten snel en efficiënt van dienst te zijn. Elke dag werken ca. 400 Steenmeesters aan hun missie; zonder dat jij het door hebt zorgt MBI voor onze leefomgeving.

jobs.title: Autopoetser / Schoonmaker
jobs.description: Specifieke ervaring als autopoetser is niet vereist. U krijgt intern een volledige opleiding. Wij verwachten wel een gemotiveerde en betrouwbare persoon die respectvol met andermans eigendom omgaat.

jobs.title: 1e Monteur Onderhoud Elektrotechniek
jobs.description: Voor een van onze relaties op TATA Steel ga je aan de slag als leidinggevend E&I monteur. Je werkt in een dagdienst of in een 2-ploegen dienst.Je werkzaamheden zijn:- het opzoeken van relevante schema's en tekeningen- het opsporen en verhelpen van storingen in het elektrisch gedeelte van MRP, schredder, handgereedschap en bedrijfsinstallaties met meetinstrumenten.- het interpreteren van de gemeten waarden en op basis hiervan bepalen van de reparatiewijze.- het verzamelen van benodigde onderdelen, componenten en materialen in afdelingsmagazijn.- het repareren of vervangen van onderdelen, zoals motoren, relais en schakelaars met gereedschappen.- het overleggen over grote of specialistische reparaties met Teamleider Onderhoud.- het onderhouden van de vrachtwagen, shredder en alle kranen als het gaat om elektrotechnische mankementen, zoals het vervangen van lampen, soldeerwerkzaam heden, bedrading etc. - Onderhoud aan de motor, uitleeswerk van gegevens en werkzaamheden waarvoor een brug nodig is.- Onderhouden van de MRP- Overgaan, indien nodig in overleg met Teamleider Onderhoud- Herstellen van de defect geraakte onderdelen- Uitvoren van het elektrotechnisch onderhoudswerk aan installaties aan de hand van werkopdrachten van de voorman en vastgesteld onderhoudsprogramma- controleren van verbindingen op vastzitten- inspecteren van schakelaar en schakelwalsen op inbranding- Controleren van kabels.- Leidinggeven aan 4 monteursVoor onze andere vacatures kijk ook even op www.werkenvoorhmb.nlVoor onze andere vacatures kijk ook even op www.werkenvoorhmb.nl

jobs.title: Coördinator Dagbesteding Geelbroekerweg Hooghalen
jobs.description: Als coördinator dagbesteding begeleid en ondersteun je bewoners met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag in hun dagelijks leven. Je coördineert de dagbesteding, vertaalt de doelen uit het persoonlijk plan naar passende activiteiten en stemt deze af met de persoonlijk begeleider, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de gedragsdeskundige. Binnen de Cirkel combineer je het werken op de dagbesteding met het werken op de woonlocatie. Zo zorg je samen met je collega's voor continuïteit, verbinding tussen wonen en dagbesteding en een eenduidige begeleidingsstijl.Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, behandelaren, verwanten en andere betrokkenen. Je stimuleert bewoners in hun ontwikkeling, zelfredzaamheid en maatschappelijke participatie, rapporteert over de voortgang en denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van nieuwe activiteiten. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten en draagt iedere dag bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en betekenisvolle leef- en werkomgeving.Samen met je collega's maak je iedere dag het verschil voor bewoners die behoefte hebben aan duidelijkheid, structuur en een omgeving waarin zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen.Wil jij bijdragen aan een betekenisvolle dag voor mensen met een intensieve ondersteuningsvraag? Een van onze collega's zet een mooie volgende stap binnen Vanboeijen. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe coördinator dagbesteding die samen met ons het verschil wil maken voor onze bewoners.Op de locatie Geelbroekerweg in Hooghalen bied je samen met je collega's een veilige, prikkelarme omgeving aan jongvolwassenen en volwassenen met complexe zorgvragen en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Wonen en dagbesteding zijn hier onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. In een warme en huiselijke omgeving lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan een waardevolle, voorspelbare en betekenisvolle dag voor de bewoners.

jobs.title: Helden in het verkeer
jobs.description: Voor de functie van verkeersregelaar: Jij bent minstens 18 jaar - Jij spreekt en begrijpt de Nederlandse taal of bent bereid dit te leren - Jij kunt een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) overhandigen (Wij dienen een verzoek in voor jouw VOG aanvraag) - Jij hebt een aanstellingspas of bent bereid deze te halen - Jij bent in het bezit van VCA Basis of bent bereid om deze te halen - Indien je in het bezit bent van een rijbewijs B, heb je een streepje voorZit veiligheid in jouw bloed en wil je er samen met jouw collega's voor zorgen dat alle weggebruikers veilig deel kunnen nemen aan het verkeer? Lees verder, dit is de vacature die jij zoekt! Als verkeersregelaar wordt je ingezet bij veranderende verkeerssituaties, evenementen en/of wegwerkzaamheden. Je werkt in de buitenlucht, tijdens alle weeromstandigheden, vaak overdag maar soms ook 's nachts. In dit werk is geen dag hetzelfde. Naast de vaste projecten, waar je voor een langere periode werkt, zijn er korte projecten die wekelijks veranderen. Onze verkeersregelaars zijn de gastheren of dames op projecten waar de doorstroom van het verkeer moeten worden begeleid. Wij bieden verkeersdeelnemers alternatieven hoe zij veilig hun bestemming kunnen bereiken. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn bouwbedrijven, aannemers in de infra, overheidsinstanties en evenementenorganisaties. Een verkeersregelaar van Jongeleen houdt van afwisseling en werkt graag in teamverband. Is deze functie echt iets voor jou? Dan wordt het tijd dat we je ontmoeten! Solliciteer direct via de onderstaande button.

jobs.title: Verzorgende IG (VIG)
jobs.description: Als verzorgende IG heb je een belangrijke functie in de zorgverlening. Naast de verpleging en begeleiding van onze bewoners, geef je een luisterend oor end raag je dagelijks bij aan hun algehele welzijn. Samen met je collega's creëer je een fijne leefomgeving voor ouderen, waarin respect voor verschillende culturen en achtergronden voorop staat.Bij Nusantara werk je in een informele, plezierige en inspirerende omgeving met betrokken collega's om samen mee op te trekken.Zie jij de mens achter onze bewoners en veranderingen in hun wensen en behoeften?
