jobs.title: Rogerz søger butikschef til Danmarks førende trading card game butik
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for åbningen af Rogerz' første butik på Fyn?

Rogerz fortsætter vores vækstrejse, og i første kvartal af 2027 åbner vi dørene til vores nye butik i Odense!

Derfor søger vi en erfaren, ambitiøs og engageret Butikschef, som får en helt central rolle i etableringen og den efterfølgende drift af vores nye butik.

Vi leder efter en stærk retailprofil, der motiveres af mennesker, ledelse og resultater, og som har lyst til at være med til at opbygge en butik og et team fra bunden.

Hvem er Rogerz?

Rogerz er en af Nordens hurtigst voksende virksomheder inden for TCG, sportskort og samleobjekter.

Vi specialiserer os i samlekort, tilbehør og collectibles fra blandt andet Pokémon, One Piece, Topps, Disney, Star Wars, Magic: The Gathering, Riftbound og mange flere.

Vi er selv samlere og entusiaster helt ind til benet, og passionen for produkterne og miljøet er en stor del af vores kultur.

Af samlere, for samlere.

Med butikker i Field's, Rødovre Centrum og Lyngby Storcenter fortsætter vi nu vores ekspansion med en ny butik i Odense.

Ambitionen er at skabe en butik, der bliver et naturligt samlingspunkt for både nye og erfarne samlere på Fyn, hvor produktviden, fællesskab og en ekstraordinær kundeoplevelse går hånd i hånd.

Din rolle som Store Manager

Som Store Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for butikkens medarbejdere, daglige drift og kommercielle resultater.

Men denne stilling er noget særligt.

Du får nemlig mulighed for at være med helt fra begyndelsen og spille en afgørende rolle i etableringen af vores nye butik.

I perioden op til åbningen vil du i tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse være med til at opbygge dit team, implementere vores standarder og procedurer og sikre, at butikken er klar til at levere en fantastisk kundeoplevelse fra første åbningsdag.

Efter åbningen bliver det dit ansvar at sikre en veldrevet, lønsom og succesfuld butik med et stærkt team, der hver dag leverer på Rogerz' ambitioner.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver blandt andet:

  • Deltage aktivt i etableringen og klargøringen af vores nye butik i Odense.

  • Rekruttere, onboarde og udvikle dit eget butiksteam.

  • Sikre en succesfuld butiksåbning og skabe et stærkt fundament for den fremtidige drift.

  • Varetage den daglige ledelse og drift af butikken med det fulde personaleansvar.

  • Udarbejde og løbende optimere vagtplaner med fokus på bemanding, produktivitet og lønomkostninger.

  • Træne, coache og udvikle medarbejderne inden for salg, kundeservice og produktviden.

  • Sikre en høj, professionel og ensartet kundeoplevelse i overensstemmelse med Rogerz' standarder.

  • Arbejde struktureret med butikkens KPI'er, omsætning, salgsmål og øvrige resultater.

  • Sikre overholdelse af butikkens løn-, bemandings- og driftsbudgetter.

  • Arbejde målrettet med salgsudvikling, mersalg og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Sikre, at virksomhedens procedurer, sikkerhedsstandarder og retningslinjer efterleves.

  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af nye initiativer, events og koncepter i samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse.

Kort sagt får du ansvaret for at bygge en butik op fra bunden, skabe et stærkt og motiveret team og sikre, at Rogerz får den bedst mulige start i Odense.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring fra retail, gerne fra en lignende lederstilling, hvor du har haft ansvar for både medarbejdere, drift og kommercielle resultater.

Du er en leder, der trives med ansvar, arbejder struktureret og formår at skabe resultater gennem dine medarbejdere.

Du ved, at en succesfuld butik kræver mere end gode salgstal. Det kræver stærk ledelse, tydelige forventninger, engagerede medarbejdere og en kundeoplevelse, der giver kunderne lyst til at komme igen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med personaleledelse inden for retail.

  • Har erfaring med rekruttering, onboarding og udvikling af medarbejdere.

  • Har stærke kompetencer inden for vagtplanlægning, bemandingsoptimering og omkostningsstyring.

  • Er vant til at arbejde målrettet med KPI'er, salgstal, budgetter og performance.

  • Har en kommerciel tankegang og evner at omsætte analyser og resultater til konkrete handlinger.

  • Er en synlig, nærværende og motiverende leder, som går forrest på butiksgulvet.

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag.

  • Har et højt ambitionsniveau og tager ejerskab for både dine medarbejderes udvikling og butikkens resultater.

  • Er selvstændig, løsningsorienteret og god til at følge dine initiativer helt til dørs.

  • Trives i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor udvikling og forandringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du tidligere har været involveret i åbningen af en ny butik eller har erfaring med at opbygge og udvikle et nyt team.

Kendskab til TCG og collectibles er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du behøver ikke kende forskellen på en Pokémon Booster Box og en Topps Hobby Box, når du starter.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, lærevillig og har lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i produkterne og det univers, som vores kunder og medarbejdere brænder for.

For os er det vigtigere at finde den rette leder med de rette kompetencer og værdier end en erfaren samler uden ledelseserfaring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Rogerz bliver du en del af en ambitiøs virksomhed i kraftig vækst, hvor du får reel mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både din egen butik og udviklingen af vores retail-organisation.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En spændende lederstilling med det samlede ansvar for vores nye butik i Odense.

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til at etablere en helt ny butik og opbygge dit eget team.

  • Stor indflydelse på butikkens daglige drift, udvikling og kommercielle resultater.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens øverste ledelse og ejerkreds.

  • Korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for hurtigt at omsætte idéer til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab, høj energi og en fælles passion for vores produkter.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling i takt med virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor initiativ, ansvarlighed og gode resultater bliver værdsat.

Vi tror på, at dygtige ledere skaber dygtige medarbejdere, og at engagerede medarbejdere skaber de bedste kundeoplevelser.

Derfor får du både ansvar, tillid og mulighed for at udvikle dig som leder hos os.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stilling: Store Manager / Butikschef

Arbejdssted: Rogerz, Odense

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

Forventet butiks åbning: Q1 2027

Tiltrædelse: Efter nærmere aftale, med mulighed for opstart inden butikkens åbning.

Løn: Efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Da vi arbejder inden for retail, vil aften- og weekendvagter være en naturlig del af jobbet.

Vi forventer, at vores kommende Store Manager bliver en aktiv del af forberedelserne frem mod åbningen, herunder rekruttering, oplæring og klargøring af butikken.

Er du vores nye Store Manager i Odense?

Kan du se dig selv stå i spidsen for vores nye butik og være med til at gøre Rogerz til en stærk destination for samlere og entusiaster på Fyn?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og CV til: job@rogerz.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Retail, Michael Kokholm Larsen på telefon 21 77 84 77.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager – Industrial Product Solutions
jobs.description: Are you passionate about industrial sales and a persistent customer value builder – do you have an innovative and proactive approach in driving business growth, bringing new perspectives and finding new solutions for industrial equipment and machine manufacturing companies? Etteplan is growing and we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join us. This is to drive growth within selected industrial equipment and machine manufacturer customers globally, including defense, energy, mining and autonomous vehicles as particular focus sectors. We place great emphasis on personal qualities and will be happy to hear from you – a curious person with a positive attitude and a passion for industrial digitalization, willing to take the next step in your career. We at Etteplan love to build teams with innovative and skilled people having a passion for creating smart solutions to industrial digitalization needs. We are a growing international technology service company with decades of experience partnering with companies in a wide range of industries. Your Role As a Senior Sales Manager, you will drive sales by discovering relevant customer needs, leading and developing opportunities, and building offers for existing and new accounts. You will focus on Finnish and international industrial equipment and machine manufacturers, helping them to advance their R&amp;D in embedded SW, electronics and HW design services and solutions ranging from consulting to turn-key projects and continuous services. You will work together with our other sales managers, delivery teams and global organization consisting of service-minded professionals. jobs.title: Part-Time Account Manager – Help Lightbooth Grow Across Europe
jobs.description:
Are you a confident communicator with a head for business and an interest in nightlife? Lightbooth is looking for an ambitious part-time Account Manager to win new customers, build relationships and turn promising conversations into sales.

Whether you’re studying or looking for a flexible part-time role, this is an opportunity to gain international sales experience and earn commission based on your results.

About Lightbooth

Lightbooth sells photobooths and selfie machines with an integrated CRM and marketing system, designed for restaurants, nightlife venues, entertainment and experience venues.

We’re a fast-growing company, with Scandinavia, the UK and Spain currently our largest markets. Your focus will be on the UK, Ireland and the Nordics, with the freedom to pursue customers throughout Europe.

Your role

You’ll find potential customers, connect with decision-makers and show them how Lightbooth can add value to their business. You’ll take ownership of the sales process, from first contact to closing the deal.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Identifying and reaching out to potential customers.

  • Presenting our photobooths and CRM and marketing system.

  • Following up on leads and turning conversations into agreements.

  • Building customer relationships across European markets.

There may be opportunities to travel for customer visits, giving you the chance to build a strong international network across the nightlife, hospitality and entertainment industries.

What you bring

You enjoy meeting new people, understand what makes a business tick and know how to turn interest into action. You’re ambitious, optimistic and persistent enough to keep a conversation moving when a deal takes time.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is a confident communicator and fluent in English.

  • Has commercial instincts and is motivated by results.

  • Takes initiative and works independently.

  • Follows through and takes ownership of their sales activities.

  • Is eager to learn and develop their sales skills.

An interest in nightlife is a big plus, especially if you understand the environment our customers work in. Additional major European languages are also an advantage, but aren’t required.

What we offer

  • Up to 15 hours per week – a good fit alongside your studies.

  • Base pay and an attractive commission scheme, rewarding the results you deliver.

  • An office in central Copenhagen, with flexibility in how you organise your work and achieve your goals.

  • Hands-on international sales experience in a fast-growing company.

  • Opportunities for customer visits across Europe and to build a valuable international network.

Interested? Let’s talk.

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself to job@lightbooth.dk. Tell us what interests you about the role and which languages you speak.

Location: CopenhagenApplication deadline: applications reviewed on a rolling basisStart date: by agreement

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

jobs.title: Elementary School Art Teacher
jobs.description: Location: Dar Essalam American School, Rabat, MoroccoType: Full-Time, Starting Date: August 2027Academic Year: 2027-2029Division: Early Childhood and Elementary School, PK3 through Grade 5Reports to: Elementary School PrincipalAbout the RoleDar Essalam American School (DAS) in Rabat, Morocco is seeking an Elementary School Art Teacher to join our international team from August 2027. The Art Teacher creates a safe, inclusive and inspiring environment where students explore visual ideas, develop artistic skills and express themselves with confidence. The teacher plans and delivers the approved visual arts curriculum, adapting learning to the developmental needs of assigned classes from PK3 through Grade 5.The Profile of a DAS Teacher guides professional practice: student-centered learning, meaningful relationships, the DAS 5Cs, the DAS identity, reflection and professional growth, and contribution to the school community.Teaching and Learning\-Plan units and lessons from the approved art curriculum and intended learning outcomes.\-Build understanding of visual elements and design principles through age-appropriate drawing, painting, collage, printmaking, sculpture and other suitable media.\-Combine explicit teaching of techniques with inquiry, experimentation and student choice.\-Use observation, student artwork, portfolios and reflection to assess progress; give constructive feedback and communicate progress against agreed expectations.\-Differentiate materials, techniques and instruction for students ages, language proficiency and support needs. In Early Childhood classes, emphasize sensory exploration, fine motor development and purposeful play.\-Introduce diverse artists and traditions, including Moroccan art, to build cultural appreciation.Students and School Culture\-Know students as individuals and build a respectful studio culture that supports belonging, creative confidence and perseverance.\-Maintain clear routines, accurate attendance, punctuality and active supervision.\-Follow safeguarding, professional boundaries, health and safety and incident reporting procedures.Collaboration and Community\-Plan collaboratively with homeroom teachers and specialist colleagues, and work with Elementary School leadership on curriculum and assessment expectations.\-Work with teaching assistants and student support staff to make art accessible to all learners.\-Build respectful, responsive relationships with parents and caregivers and communicate clearly about learning and progress.\-Contribute to school events, curate student artwork and support exhibitions that celebrate learning.\-Maintain an organized, safe art room with clear routines for handling, storing and cleaning materials.Qualifications and Experience\-A bachelors degree in Art Education, Visual Arts, Fine Arts, education or a related field, and a recognized teaching qualification appropriate to the assigned classes.\-Successful experience teaching visual arts to elementary students, with understanding of childrens creative, physical, social and emotional development. Early Childhood teaching experience is desirable.\-Strong practical art skills across suitable media and knowledge of curriculum planning, artistic inquiry, assessment, differentiation and safe classroom practice.\-Strong English communication, organization, collaboration and relationship building skills.\-Training in child protection and safeguarding.Preferred Skills\-Experience in international or culturally diverse environments.\-Familiarity with technology-based educational solutions.\-Proficiency in French and/or Arabic is an advantage.About Dar Essalam American School (DAS)Dar Essalam American School (DAS) is an international school located in the vibrant Hay Riad neighborhood of Rabat, Morocco. Situated on a sprawling five-hectare campus, DAS delivers a unique approach to global education by integrating the best of Finnish and American pedagogical practices while staying deeply rooted in Moroccan culture and values.Established by the Education Development Company (EDC), Moroccos leading education provider, DAS is a flagship institution that champions innovation, cultural understanding and academic excellence.

jobs.title: Branch Manager
Help Keep Our Capsule Hotel in Copenhagen Spotless!
jobs.description:
Do you take pride in a job well done and enjoy working independently? Our Capsule Hotel in Copenhagen is up and running, and we’re looking for reliable Housekeepers to join our team. If you have an eye for detail and like seeing the results of your work right away, this could be the perfect fit for you.

At Capsule Hotel, we’re not just offering a place to stay, we’re redefining how people travel. By blending smart design, meaningful community, and affordability, we create memorable stays for curious explorers from all over the world. And a great stay always starts with a clean, fresh space.

What Drives Us We believe in: ✔ People First: Guests, team, and partners come first. Always. ✔ GO Big: Every idea should be scalable and impactful. ✔ Strength Oriented: Do what you’re great at; we support the rest. ✔ Adapt for the Future: Innovation keeps us ahead of the curve.

The Role: Housekeeper (Hourly Basis) Location: Copenhagen Start Date: 1 December 2026 Shift: Starting at 10:00 AM, usually around 3-4 hours

As a Housekeeper, you’ll make sure every guest walks into a clean, fresh, and welcoming hotel. You’ll work independently during your shift, managing your own tasks from start to finish.

Your Mission

  • Clean and prepare the capsules for arriving guests, including changing bed linen

  • Clean and refresh the bathrooms and shower areas

  • Keep the common areas tidy and inviting

  • Restock supplies such as towels, toiletries, and cleaning products

  • Report any damage, maintenance issues, or lost items

  • Make sure everything is guest-ready by the end of your shift

What’s in It for You? ✔ A short, fixed shift that fits easily around studies, family, or another job ✔ Independence: you plan your work and own the result ✔ Part of a young, international hospitality brand that’s growing ✔ Clear routines and a supportive team behind you

Are You the One? ✅ Detail-oriented with high standards for cleanliness ✅ Reliable and punctual, since the team counts on you to have everything ready on time ✅ Comfortable working alone and staying organised without supervision ✅ Physically fit and fine with an active, hands-on job ✅ Some cleaning or housekeeping experience? Great, but not required, as we’ll train you ✅ Able to communicate in English (Danish is a plus)

If this sounds like you, don’t wait. Help us create spotless stays for travellers from around the world!

Apply now: andrea@capsulehotel.ch

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til fast stilling hos Melius Husene
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe en god hverdag for mennesker, der har brug for dig?

Hos Melius Husene søger vi en uddannet pædagog til en fast stilling.

Vi søger en kollega, der har lyst til at lære vores beboere godt at kende og være med til at skabe en tryg, stabil og meningsfuld hverdag.

Det pædagogiske arbejde hos os tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboer. Det kræver både faglighed, nærvær og evnen til at være rolig og tydelig, også når hverdagen ikke går helt som planlagt.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du tager ansvar for dit arbejde, bidrager til samarbejdet med dine kolleger og har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt sammen med os.

Borgeren kommer først

På Melius Husene arbejder vi med voksne mennesker med blandt andet autisme og udviklingshæmning, som har forskellige behov for støtte, struktur og guidning.

Fælles for vores arbejde er, at støtten tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske, dets ressourcer, behov og ønsker til hverdagen.

Borgeren kommer først.

Vi forsøger ikke at få mennesket til at passe ind i vores system. Vi forsøger at skabe rammerne omkring det enkelte menneske.

Derfor arbejder vi med en helhedsorienteret pædagogisk tilgang, hvor anerkendelse, struktur, relation og kommunikation er centrale elementer.

Du skal kunne skabe både relation og retning

Som pædagog hos os bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen omkring vores beboere og af det faglige samarbejde med dine kolleger.

Vi arbejder sammen om at skabe kontinuitet, tryghed og en fælles pædagogisk retning, samtidig med at der skal være plads til faglige refleksioner og forskellige perspektiver.

Din opgave er blandt andet at:

·        skabe tryghed og forudsigelighed i hverdagen

·        opbygge stærke og tillidsfulde relationer

·        støtte beboerne i struktur, aktiviteter og daglige gøremål

·        arbejde pædagogisk med den enkeltes ressourcer, behov og mål

·        kunne håndtere udfordrende situationer med ro og faglighed

·        observere, dokumentere og dele vigtig faglig viden

·        samarbejde med dine kolleger og ledelsen

·        bidrage aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en positiv kultur

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet pædagog, gerne med erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde.

Men din uddannelse fortæller ikke alt om, hvem du er.

For os er det mindst lige så vigtigt, at du:

·        er rolig og tydelig

·        er nysgerrig på mennesker

·        tager ansvar

·        er stabil og holder dine aftaler

·        kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig ser værdien i samarbejde

·        spørger, når du er i tvivl

·        kan modtage og give faglig feedback

·        bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

·        kan bevare ro og overblik, når en situation bliver svær

Og så skal du have lyst til at blive en del af noget.

Vi ønsker medarbejdere, der tager medansvar for arbejdspladsen og fællesskabet og ikke kun for deres egen vagt.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt

Du behøver ikke kende alle vores beboere, metoder og arbejdsgange fra første dag.

Det lærer vi dig.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har lyst til at lære.

Vi tror på, at man bliver dygtigere, når man tør stille spørgsmål, reflektere over sin egen praksis og bruge sine kolleger.

Hos os er det helt i orden at sige: “Det ved jeg ikke, hjælp mig lige.”

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Hvad får du hos os?

Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads, hvor du får mulighed for at komme tæt på det pædagogiske arbejde og følge den enkelte beboers hverdag og udvikling over tid.

Du får:

·        en fast stilling

·        et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaven sammen

·        korte veje til ledelsen

·        mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling

·        indflydelse på den pædagogiske hverdag

·        mulighed for at arbejde i dybden med den enkelte beboer

·        mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle Melius Husene

·        en arbejdsplads, hvor vi ønsker høj faglighed uden at miste menneskeligheden

Vi tror på, at en god arbejdsplads ikke skabes af én person. Den skabes af mennesker, der tager ansvar for hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og hjælper, når der er brug for det.

Måske er du den, vi mangler

Hvis du leder efter et arbejde, hvor du kan møde ind, passe din vagt og gå hjem igen, er vi måske ikke det rigtige sted.

Men hvis du gerne vil være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor relationer, faglighed, ansvar og fællesskab betyder noget, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV.

Fortæl gerne lidt om hvem du er som pædagog, hvem du er som menneske, og hvorfor du tror, Melius Husene kunne være det rigtige sted for dig.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

jobs.title: Utleierepresentant (deltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Tromsø lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (hovedsakelig annenhver helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 20%

Perfekt ved siden av studier!

Som utleierepresentant hos Sixt er du ansvarlig for å levere premium kundeopplevelser som gjenspeiler kvalitet, fleksibilitet og service i toppklasse. Våre kunder forventer det beste, og vår ambisjon er å overgå forventningene i hvert møte. Du representerer Sixt i møte med kunden og har ansvar for at tjenestene våre holder den standarden som forventes av en premium merkevare. Hverdagen styres av kundenes behov, og din evne til å arbeide effektivt, strukturert og nøyaktig er avgjørende for kvaliteten vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med på å bygge Norges beste bilutleiekjede.

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner • Presentere og anbefale våre produkter og tjenester på en profesjonell måte • Håndtere kundehenvendelser via skranke, telefon og e-post • Organisere reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte • Sikre at våre kjøretøy holder den standarden kundene forventer • Bidra til effektiv drift gjennom rapportering og administrative oppgaver • Samarbeide med kolleger for å sikre en sømløs kundeopplevelse

Hvem er du?

Du trives i møte med mennesker og motiveres av å levere service på et høyt nivå. Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og komfortabel med å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig. Du tar eierskap til arbeidet ditt og har et øye for både detaljer og helhet.

Vi ser gjerne at du har: • Førerkort klasse B • Plettfri vandel • En genuin interesse for kundeservice og gode kundeopplevelser • Gode salgs og kommunikasjonsevner • Evne til å arbeide effektivt og nøyaktig i et hektisk miljø • Struktur og oversikt i en hverdag hvor planer kan endre seg raskt • Flytende norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig • Gode datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office)

Vi tilbyr Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. Vil du være med på å levere kundeopplevelser som overgår forventningene? Da ønsker vi å høre fra deg.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö, Tilitoimisto Aarnio Oy
jobs.description: **Sinustako Palvelupäällikkömme?**Sinä, joka ymmärrät taloushallintoa, nautit Asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä, pidät langat käsissäsi ja innostut monipuolisista työtehtävistä – tämä saattaa olla juuri Sinun seuraava urasteppisi! Tilitoimisto Aarnio on vuonna 1960 perustettu tilitoimistoalan perheyritys, joka tunnetaan moderneista ja asiakaslähtöisistä taloushallintopalveluistaan.Etsimme nyt hyvän asenteen ja osaamisen omaavaa Palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turun pääkonttorillemme. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien hoitaminen ja kehittäminen, projektinhallinta sekä osallistuminen uusasiakashankintaan. Toimit tärkeänä linkkinä Asiakkaidemme, taloushallinnon asiantuntijoidemme ja johtomme välillä.**TEHTÄVÄSI PALVELUPÄÄLLIKKÖNÄ**Palvelupäällikkönä huolehdit siitä, että Asiakkaamme saavat erinomaista ja henkilökohtaista palvelua sekä siitä, että asiakkuuksiemme hoito on sujuvaa niin Asiakkaan kuin omien Tekijöidemmekin näkökulmasta.Tehtäväsi on monipuolinen ja siihen kuuluu muun muassa:\- Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen ja kehittäminen: aktiivinen yhteydenpito Asiakkaisiin, asiakastyytyväisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä Asiakkaiden kanssa pidettävät kuukausipalaverit.\- Hinnoittelun ja kannattavuuden seuranta: Asiakkaiden hintojen oikeellisuuden ja riittävyyden tarkastelu sekä tarvittavien hinnanmuutosten koordinointi.\- Asiakasvastaanottojen projektijohtaminen: erityisesti suurempien ja julkisten kilpailutusten kautta saatujen Asiakkaiden vastaanottoprojektien johtaminen, aikataulutus ja koordinointi. Varmistat, että projektit etenevät yhteisen toimintamallimme mukaisesti onnistuneesti maaliin.\- Julkiset kilpailutukset ja uusasiakashankinta: kilpailutusten aktiivinen seuranta, tarjouspyyntöihin perehtyminen sekä tarjousten valmistelu ja koostaminen yhteistyössä johdon kanssa.\- Asiakkuuksien hallinnolliset tehtävät: KYC-velvoitteiden hoitaminen, asiakastietojen oikeellisuuden valvonta sekä asiakkuuksien muutostilanteiden koordinointi.Teet lisäksi tiivistä yhteistyötä taloushallinnon esihenkilöidemme kanssa muun muassa asiakkuuksien resursoinnissa, työkuormien seurannassa ja toimintatapojen kehittämisessä.**MINKÄLAISTA TEKIJÄÄ ETSIMME?**Etsimme taloushallinnon ammattilaista, jolla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaidot sekä kyky hallita useita samanaikaisia kokonaisuuksia. Toivomme Sinulta oma-aloitteisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä, kaupallista ajattelua ja ennen kaikkea ratkaisukeskeistä työskentelyotetta. Osaat hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, kommunikoida selkeästi ja pitää huolta siitä, että sovitut asiat etenevät.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kirjanpidon osaamista tai vähintään selkeää ymmärrystä kirjanpidosta ja sen prosesseista. Tehtävään voidaan sisällyttää myös omien kirjanpitoasiakkuuksien hoitamista, mutta tehtävän tarkempaa sisältöä ja vastuualueiden painotuksia voidaan muokata valitun henkilön osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vahvuuksien mukaan. Asenne ja persoona ratkaisevat eniten.Eduksi katsomme aikaisemman kokemuksen tilitoimistoympäristöstä, vastaavista vastuutehtävistä, projektinhallinnasta sekä julkisista kilpailutuksista ja tarjousten laatimisesta. Myös Netvisorin, Fennoan ja Kohon tuntemuksesta on hyötyä. Emme kuitenkaan odota, että osaisit kaiken valmiiksi. Ennen kaikkea arvostamme oikeaa asennetta, halua kehittyä ja kykyä tarttua asioihin rohkeasti. Meillä ei tarvitse tietää kaikkea, mutta asioista pitää osata ottaa selvää.**TARJOAMME SINULLE:**\- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän kasvavassa perheyrityksessä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan toimintaamme\- Mahdollisuuden muokata tehtävänkuvaa osaamisesi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan\- Tiiviin yhteistyön taloushallinnon ammattilaistemme ja johtomme kanssa\- Modernit työvälineet, kuten M365, Netvisor, Fennoa, Koho, Taxxa.ai, Tendium\- Koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä joustavan työajan ja mahdollisuuden hybridityöskentelyyn\- Palkkauksen 2 800–3 800 €/kk osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja tehtävän tarkemman sisällön mukaan sekä monipuoliset henkilöstöedut\- Lämminhenkisen ja eteenpäin menevän työyhteisön, jossa nuttura tai kravaatti ei turhaan kiristä!**MIKÄ TILITOIMISTO AARNIO?**Tilitoimisto Aarnio on vuonna 1960 perustettu auktorisoitu tilitoimisto ja palkittu perheyritys, nyt jo kolmannessa sukupolvessa. Työllistämme yli 40 taloushallinnon ammattilaista viidessä toimipisteessämme Turussa, Riihimäellä, Loimaalla, Joensuussa ja Espanjan Aurinkorannikolla.Olemme tilitoimistoksi jo melko iso, mutta silti tarpeeksi ketterä. Päätökset tehdään lähellä ja jokainen kohdataan ihmisenä. Olemme toimialamme suunnannäyttäjä ja hyödynnämme moderneimpia taloushallinnon ratkaisuja ja tekoälyä. Meille on äärimmäisen tärkeää, että jokainen Tekijämme noudattaa yhteisiä palveluarvojamme. Haluamme, että jokainen Asiakas saa aitoa, henkilökohtaista ja laadukasta palvelua perheyhtiön mentaliteetilla.On ehkä klisee sanoa, että olemme kuin yhtä suurta perhettä, mutta sanomme sen silti. Yhteisöllisessä ilmapiirissämme jokainen saa olla oma itsensä, kaikkien ovet ovat avoinna ja kahvihuoneen naurunremakassa viihtyvät niin tarinoiden kertojat kuin niiden kuuntelijat.Voit perehtyä meihin työnantajana ja tutustua työsuhde-etuihimme täällä: https://aarnio.fi/aarnio-tyopaikkana/**MITEN HAEN?**Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Tilitoimisto Aarnio Oy, mutta rekrytointia hoitaa Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy. Jos saimme sytytettyä Sinussa ensikipinän ja koet olevasi etsimämme Palvelupäällikkö, lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden Maiju Aarniolle, etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi viimeistään 15.11.2026 mennessä!Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy rekrytointipäällikkö Maiju Aarnio, p. 050 411 0375. Toimi pian – paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.title: Klargjører (heltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Tromsø lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld, helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte. 

  • Klargjøre leiebiler i henhold til våre standarder (vask mm)

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Researcher Position in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
jobs.description:
The Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital, offers a full-time, two-year Researcher position in the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham.

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

The research group has a strong scientific and technical background in wireless communications, machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as radio frequency engineering and electronics. It collaborates closely with physician-scientists at the Intervention Centre. The Centre is internationally recognized for its scientific excellence and unique position in the field, promoting interdisciplinary research and development. You will work in a diverse and intellectually stimulating environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and scientific excellence in the development of future ICT-based healthcare solutions.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Work Tasks

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

  • Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
  • Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
  • Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
  • Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
  • Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.

Responsibilities

  • Lead research on learning-based, urgency-aware network control and distributed learning that adapts to network state and clinical priority.
  • Collaborate with the PhD fellow and master’s students.
  • Publish in leading networking venues and contribute to project management and new proposals.
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Required Qualifications

  • A PhD in computer networking, communications or computer science with a clear networking focus.
  • Publications on networking topics and demonstrated experience developing or applying machine-learning methods to networking problems.
  • Experience with network simulation, emulation or testbeds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent reinforcement learning, graph learning or federated learning.
  • Experience supervising students or contributing to research proposals.

Language Requirements

  • Very good written and spoken English.

Personal Qualities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
  • A high level of professionalism and work ethic.

We Offer

  • A full-time, two-year Researcher position. Salary according to the applicable salary scale and qualifications. Researcher salary range to be confirmed by HR but will be within 600 000 - 650 000 kr per annum.
  • Research collaboration with Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, and with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
  • A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
  • Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
  • An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
  • Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
  • Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.

Your application

  • Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position. Identify:
  • Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
  • Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
  • The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.

Supporting documents

  • A CV with a list of publications
  • Transcripts for your bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
  • Copies of your diplomas.
  • Up to three relevant publications. Briefly explain their relevance to the position and your contribution in the cover letter.
  • Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
  • Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.

Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter.

KontaktinformasjonDr, Roufaida Laidi, Project leader, PI, roufaida.laidi@ous-hf.no Prof. Ilangko Balasingham, Section leader, ilangko.balasingham@ous-research.no ArbeidsstedSognsvannsveien 20 0372 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5200529751 Stillingsprosent: 100% Engasjement Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2028 Søknadsfrist: 22.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. jobs.title: Praksisorienterede undervisere til Center for Socialt Arbejde
jobs.description:
Er du socialrådgiver med både overbygning, praksiserfaring og undervisningserfaring, og drømmer du om at anvende din erfaring til at uddanne kommende socialrådgivere? Måske har din samlede erfaring også givet dig mod på at være med til at videreuddanne praksis? Så har du chancen nu, hvor vi i Center for Socialt Arbejde (CSA) søger undervisere. I CSA er vi i gang med at opbygge en ny uddannelse jf. uddannelsesreformens intentioner om praksisnærhed og et tættere samarbejde mellem studerende og undervisere. Da vi samtidig udvikler den samlede uddannelse samt efter- og videreuddannelse, har vi brug for at udvide korpset af fastansatte undervisere. På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition, at de studerende oplever en fagligt og socialt inkluderende studiestart, hvor de med det samme kan mærke deres kommende profession, deres uddannelse og bliver del af et aktivt studieliv. Derfor bliver de studerende blandt andet trænet i at udvikle en professionel tilgang til arbejdet i studiegrupper, så de bliver bedst muligt rustet til deres kommende arbejdsliv. Koblingen mellem teoretisk og praktisk erfaring afgørende. Din profil Uddannelsesreformen forpligter os til at tilbyde de studerende mere undervisning - og samtidig skabe bedre forudsætninger for en styrket relation mellem studerende og undervisere. Derfor har vi udviklet værkstedsdage, vi tilbyder de studerende studenterudviklingssamtaler, og vi arbejder i stigende grad med gennemgående faste undervisere. Derfor er følgende afgørende: Praksiserfaring. Du har solid erfaring fra socialt arbejde, f.eks. fra kommunal myndighed (børn og unge, beskæftigelsesområdet eller det specialiserede voksenområde) - måske som udfører - eller måske helt andre nicher indenfor feltet socialt arbejde. Undervisningserfaring. Det er en forudsætning, at du har undervisningserfaring, da vi har behov for, at du kan træde direkte ind i underviserrollen. Du har dermed også allerede mærket, at du trives med undervisning som hovedarbejdsopgave. Teamsamarbejde og koordinering. Du har erfaret, at det kræver et stærkt og ligeværdigt teamsamarbejde at lykkes med kvalificeret undervisning. Du deler ansvar og opgaver med dine kolleger, når I kobles sammen om opgaverne. Du har måske også oplevet, at det at være en del af et team, gør at arbejdsopgaven er lettere at gå til - at I løfter i flok. Fleksibilitet. I uddannelsesverdenen er meget planlagt i rigtig god tid. Trods dette vilkår er du er indforstået med, at der sker uforudsete ændringer, og du er vant til at håndtere disse konstruktivt og med et ansvarligt og samarbejdende mindset. Det er vores forventning, at du har:
  • grunduddannelse som socialrådgiver
  • overbygning med f.eks.. relevant master- eller kandidatgrad.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Din primære opgave er undervisning af fremtidens socialrådgivere samt efter-videreuddannelse af praktikere indenfor det socialfaglige felt. De konkrete opgaver er: At udvikle, planlægge og undervise på både grunduddannelse samt på efter- og videreuddannelse. Dette sker i tæt samspil med de studerende, dine kolleger og i samarbejde med såvel interne som eksterne samarbejdspartnere. På sigt vil der være mulighed for at indgå i forsknings- og udviklingsopgaver. At bidrage til et aktivt og socialt studiemiljø. Vi lægger vægt på, at studiemiljøerne er præget af et socialt liv samt glade og engagerede studerende, der kan få kompetent sparring og støtte, både i studiegrupper og fra deres vejledere. Dine kolleger CSA udbyder socialrådgiveruddannelsen i Roskilde, Slagelse og Nykøbing
  1. Du bliver primært tilknyttet ét campus, dog med forventning om en vis fleksibilitet ift. at kunne varetage undervisning på flere af vores campusser. Som udgangspunkt får du arbejdssted på vores campus i Roskilde.
I CSA er vi ca. 65 engagerede og ambitiøse kolleger, der værdsætter samarbejde og vidensdeling i en respektfuld og uformel omgangstone. Vi er socialt og fagligt velfunderede, og påskønner faglig sparring og udvikling i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi tilstedeværelse på campus, hvor vi blandt andet forkæles med en fremragende kantine- og frokostordning. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde i et vist omfang. Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.900, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 54.200, - kr. inkl. pension. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest 1. december 2026.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Lisette Kaptain på telefon 7248 2963 eller lkap@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 10. november 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 17. november 2026
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Alt efter dine kvalifikationer bliver du ansat som adjunkt eller lektor På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde. Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/413 Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/414 Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Supervior Piping
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining future-oriented engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels for a wide range of market segments, including offshore energy, naval, fisheries, icebreaking and research. At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength.  We need people with a wide range of skills, professional backgrounds, and experience. Engineers, designers, skilled workers, project managers, finance professionals, procurement specialists and many others all work together towards a common goal. Different perspectives and areas of expertise are essential to delivering high-quality vessels. To be able to build the ships of tomorrow today, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact. 

 

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Supervisor Piping to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?

Duties and responsibilities
  • Plan and coordinate piping installation and commissioning activities.
  • Coordinate personnel and subcontractors to meet project milestones.
  • Monitor progress, quality and performance throughout the project.
  • Prepare areas and systems for inspections and follow up remarks and non-conformities.
  • Ensure necessary materials and documentation are available for production.
  • Identify and resolve challenges that may impact progress, quality or cost.
  • Report installation and commissioning progress to relevant stakeholders.
Qualifications
  • Vocational education, or relevant experience that can compensate for formal education.
  • Experience and good technical understanding of piping systems, installation and commissioning.
  • Ability to understand technical, construction and functional drawings.
  • Basic knowledge of classification rules, including DNV and Bureau Veritas.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Ability to work with 3D drawing viewers.
  • Good English skills, both written and spoken.
  • Knowledge of safe working methods and practices.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Good leadership, coordination and communication skills.
  • Self-driven and proactive in solving operational challenges.
  • Structured, reliable and responsible.
  • Able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Practical and solution-oriented approach.
  • Comfortable coordinating people and activities in a dynamic production environment
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Why you'll enjoy working at VARD

 At VARD, you'll join an international company where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are part of everyday work. We are committed to creating an environment where people thrive, grow, and succeed together. 

As part of our team, you'll benefit from: 

  • Exciting and meaningful work in a global maritime environment 
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth 
  • A competitive pension scheme and comprehensive insurance coverage 
  • Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 
  • Subsidized lunch in our office canteen 
  • Subsidized gym membership to support your health and wellbeing 
  • Occupational health services 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Modern office facilities with free parking 

At VARD, we also know that a great workplace is about more than just work. Through Social by VARD, you'll have the opportunity to connect with colleagues across teams and locations through a wide range of social activities and events. From fjord cruises, hiking, and cooking classes to football practice, go-karting, and wine tasting, there are plenty of opportunities to build relationships, share experiences, and create lasting memories.

ContactsLars Erik Slyngstadli, Department Manager Pipe Installation, +47 99219634 LocationPostvegen 2 6018 Ålesund Key information:Employer: Vard Interiors AS Reference number: 5200511637 Percentage of full-time: 100% Regular Application deadline: 01/12/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vard Interiors AS is a specialized company for interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R installation in Vard Group AS. Our company is present in VARD shipyards in Norway, Romania, and Vietnam. We have also established a subsidiary in Romania.

jobs.title: Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development (combined position)
jobs.description:
Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development 

A combined position as Professor (50%) and as Research Director (50%) is vacant at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and at the Centre for Shared Decision Making, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, respectively.

The position is offered for five years, with the possibility of extension.

The academic positionThe professor will advance research into shared decision-making (SDM) and the involvement of patients and their relatives, as well as the professional development required to integrate these approaches into clinical practice. The professor will be part of the management team at the joint centre at Lillebælt Hospital and will foster coherence between research, education and implementation. The professor will be appointed at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU. The academic field combines SDM with professional development for healthcare professionals. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration across clinical settings are expected and central to the position.

Research leadership and responsibilitiesAt Lillebaelt Hospital, the professor/appointee will serve as Research Director. Together with the Centre Director, the Research Director forms the joint center leadership. The Research Director has line management responsibility for academic staff and overall scientific and strategic responsibility for research activities associated with the Center for Shared Decision Making (CFFB) and the Center for Involvement of Relatives (CEPI). The two leadership roles work closely together on the development of the centers.

The professor is expected responsible for:

  • Strategic Research Leadership and Centre ManagementThe position as professor includes overall scientific and strategic responsibility for the research units affiliated with both CFFB and CEPI as well as their interdisciplinary research group. This includes line management and academic leadership of researchers, ensuring the stable operation of the centers, and maintaining strategic oversight of the centers’ grant portfolio and funding pipeline.

  • Fundraising and External Research FundingThe professor is expected to secure substantial external research funding from national and international funding bodies to ensure the long-term sustainability and development of the centers’ research activities.

  • Practice-Oriented Empirical ResearchThe professor is expected to develop and lead empirical research SDM projects with a particular focus on the perspectives of patients, relatives, and healthcare professionals within different diseases, specialties and healthcare settings, while contributing to the advancement of qualitative and applied research methodologies such as action research.

  • Development of Educational Resources, Curriculum Design, and Educational TransformationThe position requires designing and developing practical educational tools and implementation resources — e.g., learning materials — that support healthcare professionals’ learning and continuing professional development in clinical practice performing SDM.

  • Teaching, lecturing, supervising and disseminating knowledgeThe professor should teach and mentor postdocs, PhD students, and undergraduate students. Participation in assessment work is part of the position. Additionally, profiling this research area in the public eye will be an important task.

Research activity, network and collaborationThe candidate is expected to demonstrate prior experience with research activities in terms of networks and collaborations. The professor is expected to increase research activity at the research unit and to expand collaboration with other researchers at hospitals in the Region of Southern Denmark, at SDU, the rest of Denmark and internationally.

The position as Research Director at the Centre for Shared Decision Making (CFFB)The Professorship in Shared Decision-making and Professional Development at the Center for Shared Decision Making, Vejle, Denmark, is established to support the continued implementation of Lillebaelt Hospital’s research strategy and the hospital’s overarching commitment to placing the patient at the center of care.

Over the past decade, the Center has conducted research on evidence-based approaches to SDM and has demonstrated that SDM is associated with high patient satisfaction and improved adherence to agreed treatment plans. The professorship will build on this strong research foundation by advancing knowledge on the implementation of SDM and the continuing professional development of healthcare professionals. International research consistently shows that achieving sustained and authentic SDM practice in everyday clinical care remains a significant implementation challenge. Changing professional practices and departmental cultures requires more than time-limited projects or implementation initiatives. Sustainable integration of SDM depends on ongoing and continuous competence development that supports long-term changes in clinical practice.

This professorship is positioned at the intersection of health sciences research, implementation in clinical practice, and professional development through applied educational research. The core purpose of the position is to strengthen and transform the healthcare system’s capacity for meaningful patient and family involvement through SDM.

The professorship requires strategic research leadership from a scholar with extensive expertise in lifelong learning, learning theory, curriculum theory, and action research, and with the ability to translate this knowledge into continuing professional development for healthcare professionals. The professor is expected to lead the national and international research agenda on how SDM can be integrated meaningfully and sustainably into routine clinical practice, to achieve enduring behavioral change among healthcare professionals.

QualificationsThe required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent post-graduate research qualification and demonstrate scientific achievements at a level appropriate for appointment as Professor.

  • The position calls for expertise in educational science as applied to the professional development of healthcare staff or other types of welfare staff, together with substantial knowledge of and research contributions to SDM.

  • The applicant should be able to demonstrate experience of teaching and lecturing at university and postgraduate level, as well as experience as principal supervisor on PhD projects and academic assessment work, as evidenced by the teaching portfolio.

  • Danish language skills are not required at the time of appointment, but must be mastered at proficiency level C1, at the Common European Framework of References for Languages within the first 2 years of employment.

The ideal candidate preferably demonstrates:

  • The candidate should demonstrate experience with leadership capacity with the ability to lead research teams, drive cultural change, and contribute strategically to the development of the centers.

  • The candidate holds experience in research management, interdisciplinary collaboration, and attraction of external funding for professional development and/or SDM-oriented activities will be considered an advantage.

  • The candidate preferably demonstrates experience with practice-oriented empirical research. Research that is aimed at both an international research community, and ideally also at the target group of professionals in Denmark; therefore, publications and outputs are welcome to be in Danish – whether in the form of books, leaflets, journal publications or other material designed to ensure that both professionals undertaking continuing professional development in Denmark and students on undergraduate program are best supported and thereby ensuring impact.

  • The candidate has prior experience with developing, implementing, and/or evaluating educational programs, frameworks, and curricula for continuing professional development, preferably in terms of SDM-related competencies. Experience of developing and evaluating continuing professional education in clinical settings is valued.

  • The preferred candidate can motivate and supervise, has proven research management skills, good interpersonal skills in charge of a research group, and has a clear vision for how to further strengthen the research unit at CFFB as strong interpersonal and collaborative skills are essential.

  • The successful applicant will have documented experience of leading research and researchers, obtain external funding and work across disciplines and organizations.

EmployersCFFB is a national knowledge and competence center based at Lillebaelt Hospital. Since 2014, it has researched SDM and since 2019 developed approaches for implementation in clinical practice. CEPI works to strengthen meaningful involvement of relatives. The centers retain their distinct areas of responsibility while collaborating closely on research and practice. Lillebaelt Hospital provides somatic and mental healthcare across sites in Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart. Patient and family involvement is central to their approach to care.

SDU's Department of Regional Health Research links research and education with hospitals and clinical environments across the Region of Southern Denmark. The Department of Regional Health Research supports research in relation to the person as a whole, the good life and the more common diseases, makes out a platform for scientists and educators and builds a bridge between University of Southern Denmark, The Region of Southern Denmark, the hospitals in the region and the patient. The department focuses on the continuity of patient care across sectors, hospitals, and specialist fields.

Reference The professor and research director will refer to the hospital management regarding matters concerning the management of the centres, and to the Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, Mikkel Brabrand, in matters regarding the professorship.

Contact informationFurther information concerning the position can be obtained by contacting:

  • The Research Coordinator at Lillebælt Hospital, Jonna Skov Madsen, Jonna.Skov.Madsen@rsyd.dk, +45 30507825

  • The Director of the Centre, Karina Olling, Karina.Olling@rsyd.dk, +45 51518696

  • The Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, SDU, Mikkel Brabrand, mbrabrand@health.sdu.dk, +45 93534980

Salary and terms of employmentThe successful applicant for the professor position will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Professor is salaried in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and on terms corresponding to salary grade 37 of the Danish state salary system. Additional qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Center for Shared Decision Making (Center for Fælles Beslutningstagning), Beriderbakken 4, 7100 Vejle, Denmark.

ApplicationOnly applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • An application

  • A detailed CV

  • Degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma or equivalent)

  • A complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position (please notice that one pdf file must be attached for each publication)

  • It is permitted to merge the 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications into a single PDF file due to upload constraints.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • Track record in obtaining research funding

  • National and international research collaboration and collaborations with researchers in other disciplines and sectors

  • A research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. Incomplete applications with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

The application deadline is 11 November 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)
