jobs.title: Sales Representative (UK Market)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

 

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

 

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

 

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

 

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

 

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

 

Excited about this role?

We’d love to hear from you. Please apply via our career portal with your CV and cover letter.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Work location: Oslo, Norway (Hybrid)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to pursue a doctoral degree and explore how mobile networks can work together to keep critical services running when facing failures or congestion?

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks. As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in business, administration, higher education and research.

The position is fully funded and will run for 4 years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline, and the workplace will be in Trondheim.

About the project

Mobile networks increasingly support critical services in emergency response, industry, transport, and maritime operations. Access to several networks can improve resilience, but sustaining a service requires more than restoring connectivity. Independently operated networks must coordinate resources and priorities while managing dependencies and commitments to existing users. They may also depend on shared infrastructure or capacity leased from one another, limiting the resilience gained from access to multiple operators. Norway’s plans for a new emergency network (Nødnett) over commercial mobile infrastructure illustrate the relevance of these broader challenges.

As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how mobile networks can cooperate to maintain critical services during failures, congestion, and recovery. Your research will address networks that retain their own operational policies and exchange limited information about capacity and internal state, developing insights applicable across public and private networks. A specific focus will be on the networked systems mechanisms, data paths, and open interfaces needed to support resilient service continuity in multi-operator mobile network systems, addressing research questions such as:

  • What information must networks exchange to make effective admission and resource-allocation decisions without requiring full visibility into each other’s infrastructure?
  • How can service priorities and resource policies be coordinated across heterogeneous networks, including during congestion and large bursts of registration requests?
  • How can network selection, traffic steering, and recovery mechanisms maintain application continuity while avoiding repeated switching and overload cascades?
  • How do shared infrastructure, leased capacity, and dependencies between operators affect failure propagation and the resilience gained from alternative network access?

With the Beyond 5G lab at the department, the project will emphasize experimental systems research: you will have the opportunity to conduct your research in both commercial and open-source mobile network deployments and test your ideas under realistic conditions. To explore conditions beyond the scale of the physical deployments, methods including simulation and analytical modeling can be a complementary building block.

Duties of the position
  • Complete doctoral education and obtain a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the Networking research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching in courses related to networking
  • Other career-enhancing work

Some changes to your work duties may occur after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Information Security and Communication Technology, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
    • You must have a relevant master's degree in communication networks, wireless and mobile communications, information security and distributed systems, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
    • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and preferably within August 2027.
    • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
    • If you are in your master’s program, integrated PhD could be an option. Your MSc grades after your fourth year need to be completed with a grade B or better, in addition the IE-faculty require that your bachelor degree is completed with a grade C or better. Integrated PhD - Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - NTNU.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Practical experience with 5G radio access and core deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with communication networks including multi-vendor and softwarized environments.
  • Exposure to resilience and dependability topics in the context of communication networks as part of the master’s curriculum.
  • Teaching experience, preferably at master’s level.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are

  • Highly motivated by fundamental scientific research with practical relevance.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Able to work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them.
  • Eager to disseminate research results both locally as well as through publications and presentations at international conferences.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation, in terms of the qualifications specified in the advertisement.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to one year of career promotion work.

The successful candidate will be granted conditional admission to the relevant doctoral programme when employed in the PhD position. It is a prerequisite for continued employment that the requirements for full admission are met within three months, and that you continue to participate in the organized doctoral programme for the remainder of the employment period. For more information about the requirements for full admission, please see Section 6 of the PhD regulations. 

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The application and all required attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no before the deadline. The documents must be in Norwegian, another Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. If you are invited for an interview, you must present certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for bachelor's and master's degrees, including diploma supplement
  • CV filled out in Jobbnorge
  • Copy of master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages, written in English) including a brief problem formulation, research questions, methodological approach, and an initial progress plan for the project.
  • Short letter of motivation (max. 400 words / 1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Any relevant certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts of, your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution does not offer “diploma supplement”, you must attach information about the grading scale from the education institution. 

We further recommend that you enclose a statement about your education abroad from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir). Follow the link to their web site for more information about how to obtain such a statement: Apply for recognition of foreign higher education. See also NTNU’s web site for documentation requirements for education obtained outside Norway. 

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Stanislav Lange, e-mail: stanislav.lange@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Executive Officer HR Julie Lindland e-mail: julie.lindland@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 30.11.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology

Research is vital to the security of our society. We teach and conduct research in cyber security, information security, communications networks and networked services. Our areas of expertise include biometrics, cyber defence, cryptography, digital forensics, security in e-health and welfare technology, intelligent transportation systems and malware. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
jobs.description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo sarà assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. jobs.description:
Pasts meklē Tevi, Jaunāko kiberdrošības speciālistu, kurš  interesējas par kiberdrošību, vēlas attīstīt savu profesionālo pieredzi IT drošības jomā un ir gatavs iesaistīties drošības pārbaužu, incidentu uzraudzības un organizācijas kiberdrošības pilnveidošanas aktivitātēs.

Mēs Tev uzticēsim:

  • Veikt kiberdrošības kontroļu un IT sistēmu atbilstības pārbaudes, tai skaitā piekļuves tiesību, konfigurāciju un žurnālfailu auditus.
  • Piedalīties kiberdrošības pārbaužu, ievainojamību skenēšanas un risku novērtēšanas procesos, sadarbojoties ar IT komandām identificēto risku novēršanā.
  • Sekot līdzi drošības kontroļu un auditu rekomendāciju ieviešanai, koordinējot sadarbību ar iesaistītajām pusēm.
  • Piedalīties kiberdrošības politiku, procedūru un vadlīniju izstrādē, uzturēšanā un pilnveidošanā.
  • Veikt ikdienas drošības notikumu monitoringu, identificēt aizdomīgas aktivitātes un atbalstīt incidentu reģistrēšanas un izmeklēšanas procesus.
  • Sagatavot atskaites par kiberdrošības un atbilstības rādītājiem, kā arī dokumentēt incidentus un ieviestos uzlabojumus.
  • Veicināt kiberdrošības izpratni organizācijā, sagatavojot informatīvos materiālus un sniedzot atbalstu kolēģiem ar IT drošību saistītos jautājumos.

Tev nepieciešams:

  • Izglītība vai studijas informācijas tehnoloģiju, kiberdrošības vai saistītā jomā.
  • Izpratne par informācijas drošības pamatprincipiem, piekļuves pārvaldību un IT risku

jobs.description:

No Tevis sagaidām:

  • vismaz 1 gada profesionālo darba pieredzi finanšu sektora regulējuma vai finanšu tirgus dalībnieku uzraudzības jomā;

  • zināšanas par Latvijas Republikas un Eiropas Savienības finanšu sektora regulējuma ietvaru;

  • vēlmi mācīties, apgūt jaunas zināšanas un prasmes un augt kopā ar komandu;

  • spēju analizēt regulējumu un piedāvāt praktiskus risinājumus tā piemērošanai;

  • spēju konceptuāli un analītiski domāt;

Tööülesanded: Kõiki tehnilisi töid ei saa teha hooldusjuhendi järgi. Mõnikord tuleb sobiv lahendus ise välja mõelda, valmistada ja tööle panna.Kui sulle meeldib lisaks remondile ehitada, kohandada ning lahendada tehnilisi ülesandeid, millele valmis vastust alati olemas ei ole, võib Gravenori Pärnu esindus olla just sinu järgmine töökoht. Gravenori Pärnu esinduses tegeleme lisaks tehnika hooldusele ja remondile suuremate ümberehituste, pealisehituste ning kliendi vajadustele loodud erilahendustega. Ühel päeval võib töös olla tõstuki või rasketehnika remont, järgmisel hüdraulika- või elektrisüsteemi ümberehitus ning seejärel suurem projekt, kus masinale tuleb sobiv lahendus valmistada, paigaldada ja tööle seadistada. Töö hõlmab sõltuvalt projektist: - rasketehnika, tõste- ja laotehnika remonti; - mehaanika-, hüdraulika- ja elektritöid; - masinate ning seadmete ümberehitamist; - pealisehituste ja lisaseadmete paigaldamist; - rikete diagnoosimist ja tehniliste lahenduste leidmist; - suuremate eriprojektide teostamist algusest lõpuni. Siin ei ole iga tööpäev ühesugune ning alati ei piisa ainult detaili väljavahetamisest. Oluline on oskus kaasa mõelda, leida töötav lahendus ja viia alustatud töö lõpuni.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Office of the President
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to partner directly with Replit’s President, Michele Catasta. As Replit leads in making useful intelligence accessible to all, you will serve as the company President's primary operational and strategic force multiplier across these critical organizations.

Your mandate is to own the most complex cross-functional challenges, unblock technical and operational bottlenecks, and ensure that the core product, engineering, and organizational engines operate with speed, coherence, and precision.

This is a high-leverage individual contributor (IC) role, not a traditional management track or team-building post. You will scale your personal leverage through AI workflows, agentic automation, and rigorous analytical judgment, influence, not headcount. You are the operator Michele turns to when an issue spans multiple disciplines such as technical architecture, product execution, support feedback loops, or organizational design and demands a single, decisive owner.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Act as Trusted Advisor & Operational Stand-in: Serve as a direct thought partner and proxy for Michele. Elevate core operational insights, synthesize briefings for high-stakes technical and organizational decisions, and step in as a representative when needed.

 - Proactively Clear Cross-Functional Friction: Anticipate blind spots and resolve organizational bottlenecks before they escalate. Bridge natural seams between Engineering, Product, Support, AI teams to ensure high-cadence execution.

 - Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Complex Initiatives: Spearhead high-priority projects that lack a neat functional home such as evolving product unit economics, developer tooling infrastructure shifts, pricing models, or technical re-architectures.

 - Scale Impact via AI & Automation: Actively build and deploy AI agents, automation pipelines, and modern operational workflows to multiply your personal bandwidth across status synthesis, metrics tracking, scenario modeling, and operational monitoring.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not a Routine Data / BI Role: You will not be building routine dashboards, running routine SQL queries, or handling standard quarterly analytics. Those belong to Data, RevOps, and Strategic Finance.

 - Not Bureaucracy or Process for Process’s Sake: We prioritize momentum, rapid iteration, and decisiveness over heavy governance frameworks or dense slide decks.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 7+ Years in High-Growth Tech: Proven track record in strategy, operations, product operations, or technical chief of staff roles, with extensive time spent working shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product leadership.

 - Cross-Domain Credibility: Strong technical fluency to earn the respect of Staff/Principal Engineers and AI researchers, paired with the operational empathy to partner effectively with Support and People teams.

 - Exceptional Execution in Ambiguity: The ability to take ill-defined, sprawling problems, define clean problem boundaries, and drive them to resolution without formal line authority.

 - Strong Quantitative & Analytical Toolkit: Deep comfort evaluating unit economics, interrogating technical systems data, building scenario models, and separating actionable signal from noise.

 - Executive-Ready Communication: Direct, concise communicator who can deliver unambiguous trade-offs and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and brevity.

 - Hands-on AI & Agent Automation: Active, practical experience leveraging LLM workflows, coding agents, and automation frameworks to amplify daily productivity and analytical depth.

 - Presence & Proximity: Continual availability is essential. Ability to work in-person (at least) three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) in Foster City, CA, collaborating closely on-site with leadership.

 - Scale Experience: Experience navigating rapid organizational scaling while maintaining high cultural and engineering standards.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Deep Developer Tooling Background: Prior experience in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, AI coding assistants, or developer-focused software ecosystems.


HOW WE’LL KNOW IT’S WORKING

 - Decision Velocity Across Functions Increases: Product, engineering, and support initiatives move from scoping to execution faster, with clear alignment and measurable business impact.

 - Net-Negative Friction: Teams actively seek your partnership because your involvement removes ambiguity, sharpens priorities, and unblocks progress rather than introducing overhead.

 - Integrated Health Sightlines: Replit's President has continuous, high-signal visibility into the operating health, technical execution, and organizational sentiment across all reporting groups.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description: Priority deadline: October 27. Complete the short form at https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn, then email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the subject line "EA application, FULL NAME." STILLART · FULL TIME · SOUTHERN FINLAND, WITH WEEKLY TIME IN PERSONFor two decades, StillArt has helped orchestras and arts organizations fill their halls. The company works. What it needs now is someone to protect the mind behind it.A COMPANY ON SOLID GROUND StillArt (Finland) and its associated companies are established and profitable, with about €2 million in annual turnover, a team of four, and two dozen suppliers in a dozen countries. Unique products and clear plans for international growth mean this role grows as the companies do.THE ROLE As Executive Assistant, you guard the CEO's energy, momentum and focus, so his hours go where they are worth the most: winning clients, solving the problems only the CEO can solve, building the brand and starting what comes next. Everything that pulls him out of that zone, you take, and you take it so well he never has to look back. This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions. It is a partnership. You lead the daily rhythm, you arrive with the agenda, and within three months you are anticipating the next move.WHAT YOU WILL OWN This is a role with real ownership. From your first weeks, these are yours: The inbox. You triage, decide and reply, so only what truly needs the CEO reaches him. The calendar. You manage scheduling across the companies in the group, guard focus time and prepare the week ahead. Follow-through. Loose ends close because you close them, with the team, leads and clients. Momentum. You keep notes, actions and the project list moving, so the best ideas actually get implemented. Travel and events. Conferences, flights and hotels arranged to a high standard. Purchases and payments. Handled correctly, within limits the CEO sets. Voice and visibility. Social posts and copy coordinated with the right people. The daily rhythm. A short morning check-in and an end-of-day hand-off that previews tomorrow's one big thing. Planning together. You plan and prioritize alongside the CEO, with more independence as trust grows, and you serve as a sounding board when it is time to decide which ideas earn traction now.WHY THIS ROLE IS SOUGHT AFTER A seat beside the founder. You work directly with the CEO, close enough to shape the company's next chapter. A role built with you. The scope is designed around the person who takes it, and you carry the responsibility to build it. A 90-day path. A structured training program, in three stages, so you are never left guessing how to be impactful.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Calm in motion. Steady when plans change fast. Proactive by instinct. You see what needs doing before you are asked. Curious and always learning. New tools, new products, new markets, new ways of working, including AI. The CEO has a voracious appetite for learning. Entrepreneurial at heart. At home in a founder-led company where change moves quickly, and energized by growth. Experienced and discerning. You have run a busy executive's day before, as an executive assistant or in a similar supporting role, and senior team members take you seriously. Strong with people. A real listener who makes a room feel safe. You guide as much as you assist. Trusted with what matters. Discreet with sensitive information, trusted with visibility of company and personal money, and comfortable with finance basics. Careful with detail. You would rather get it right than get it fast. To show us, add the word intern to the last field on the application form. Fluent in Microsoft tools. StillArt runs on Microsoft 365, including Planner, OneDrive, Outlook and Copilot. You work in it with ease and, ideally, help the team get more out of it by showing how our processes can be set up. Warm, with boundaries. Helpful and friendly, and honest about what is sustainable. Culture oriented. You care about the arts and about being of service to arts organizations. Experience in the arts is a plus. At home across languages and cultures. English is a must. German is a strong advantage, as this is StillArt's long term target market. Swedish (the CEO's mother tongue) and Finnish (the dominant language of the home country) are valued, and other languages are welcome as the company grows globally.WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This role guards the CEO's time. It does not carry the sales pipeline, own bookkeeping or financial modeling, or run operations or manage the team. Those sit in other seats at StillArt.THE DETAILS Employer: StillArt Limited Ab Employment: Employee, full time, Monday to Friday, working roughly 9:00 to 17:00 Helsinki time Target start: Mid-November 2026 Location: Ideally based in Finland, able to meet in person once a week in Porvoo. Candidates living elsewhere in the EU, EEA or Switzerland are encouraged to apply. Working style: Mostly remote, with regular time in person, ideally weekly Salary range: €3,500 to €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience and languages. Open to more for a candidate who clearly shows the added value they bring.HOW TO APPLY Apply through the short form here: https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn. It takes about 10 minutes. After you submit it, please email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the role and your full name in the subject line. Example: EA application, FULL NAME. We review applications once both arrive, so early applications are strongly encouraged. Priority deadline: Oct 27. Applications received after that date may still be considered while the role remains open. StillArt is a founder-led firm in Porvoo, Finland that helps orchestras and performing arts organizations grow their audiences and revenue, with clients around the world. Learn more at stillart.com.

jobs.title: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasksThe position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Vær med til at gøre frokostpausen lidt bedre – vi søger en køkkenmedhjælper til Haderslev Katedralskole
jobs.description:
Kan du lide at have hænderne i maden, et smil på læben og mange bolde i luften? Trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både laver lækker mad, møder gæsterne ved disken og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler på holdet hos DinnerdeLuxe på Haderslev Katedralskole.

Vi søger en serviceminded køkkenmedhjælper til et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen. Du har gerne mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift, er vant til at tage fat og ved, hvad der skal til for at få en travl kantinehverdag til at glide.

Det er stillingen krydret med:

  • Et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen med arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 8.00 og 14.30

  • En afvekslende hverdag med både madproduktion, gæsteservice og praktiske opgaver

  • Et moderne kantinekoncept med fokus på god mad og gode råvarer

  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar og være med til at skabe gode frokostoplevelser

God mad, glade gæster og en hverdag med fart på

I kantinen på Haderslev Katedralskole er du med til at give elever og medarbejdere en god pause i hverdagen. Her handler det ikke kun om at få maden på bordet, men også om at skabe en hyggelig og imødekommende oplevelse for dem, der besøger kantinen.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt. Den ene stund er du i gang med at tilberede mad, og den næste står du ved kassen og møder gæsterne med et smil. Du er ikke bange for at tage fat, og du ved, at de små detaljer gør en stor forskel.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tilberede og klargøre velsmagende mad til kantinens gæster

  • Betjene kassen og give gæsterne en god og venlig service

  • Anrette, fylde op og sørge for, at kantinen altid fremstår indbydende

  • Hjælpe med opvask, rengøring og de praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

  • Bidrage til, at den daglige kantinedrift fungerer godt

Du har styr på kantinehverdagen – og smil på læben

Du behøver ikke være uddannet kok eller cater. Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring fra en kantine, kan lide at arbejde med mad og trives med både de praktiske opgaver og kontakten til gæsterne.

Vi ser gerne, at du har mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift og derfor hurtigt kan finde dig til rette i en hverdag, hvor der nogle gange er fart på.

Vi glæder os til en kollega, der:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for sine opgaver

  • Har erfaring med madproduktion og den daglige drift af en kantine

  • Er serviceminded og møder gæsterne med et smil

  • Er fleksibel, har overblik og gerne giver en ekstra hånd

  • Bidrager med godt humør og en positiv indstilling

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Vi vil gerne have dig med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Der er tale om et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat – så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV, meget gerne med referencer, til job.kenneth@dinnerdeluxe.dk, og skriv "Køkkenmedhjælper Haderslev" i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Drifts- og Kundechef Kenneth Kirkedal Thomsen på telefon 25 28 28 88 eller ovenstående mailadresse.

Hvis du oplyser referencer, betragter vi det som samtykke til, at vi må kontakte dem. Af hensyn til GDPR skal du sende din ansøgning til ovenstående mailadresse. Oplys kun de nødvendige personoplysninger, såsom navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Aalborg - bliv en del af vores team
jobs.description:
Har du styr på forarbejdet og sans for en flot lakering? Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Aalborg søger vi en autolakerer, der vil bruge sin faglighed i en varieret hverdag med gode kollegaer. Vi går op i at levere kvalitet og i at have et værksted, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen.

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Herudover håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

En hverdag med biler og godt håndværk

Sammen med afdelingens øvrige lakspecialister arbejder du med:

  • Klargøring af biler til lakering gennem spartling, slibning og afdækning.
  • Reparation af mindre buler og ridser.
  • Sprøjtelakering og sikring af en flot, ensartet overflade.
  • Kvalitetskontrol, inden bilen går videre.
  • Koordinering af dagens opgaver med resten af teamet.
  • Andre opgaver i afdelingen, når der er brug for en ekstra hånd.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har en uddannelse som autolakerer eller erfaring med autolakering.
  • Går omhyggeligt til opgaverne og følger dem helt til dørs.
  • Kan organisere dit arbejde og holde overblikket i en travl hverdag.
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og samarbejde.
  • Møder dine kollegaer med en positiv indstilling og godt humør.
  • Har kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, pension og overenskomst.
  • Gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter til det daglige arbejde.
  • Mulighed for at bygge videre på din erfaring og udvikle dig i faget.
  • Et godt kollegialt fællesskab med plads til faglig sparring og en god snak i pauserne.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og søger en kollega, der passer godt ind både fagligt og personligt. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette. Lyder det som en arbejdsplads for dig? Så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Byens Bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og er i dag en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas. Hos Byensbilpleje.com håndterer vi mere end 200.000 biler om året og har mere end 400 medarbejdere.

Din arbejdsdag byder på klargøring og lakering af biler. Du spartler, sliber og afdækker, udbedrer mindre buler og ridser og udfører sprøjtelakering. Undervejs sikrer du, at kvaliteten er i orden, og at hver opgave bliver afsluttet ordentligt. Du planlægger dine opgaver i samspil med resten af teamet og hjælper med afdelingens øvrige arbejde efter behov.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Ordne buler, spartle, slibe og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), så bilerne står som nye.
  • Bidrage til at kvaliteten altid er i top.
  • Tage ansvar for egne arbejdsopgaver, og hjælpe resten af teamet, når der er brug for det.

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for finish.
  • Tager ansvar og hjælper dine kollegaer.
  • Har kørekort til personbil.
  • Du må også gerne have humor og sætte pris på, at der er plads til en god bemærkning i løbet af dagen.

Hos os får du

Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, overenskomst og pension. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk bliver værdsat. Hos os får du adgang til gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter samt mulighed for at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt. Hverdagen byder på dygtige kollegaer, godt humør og en uformel omgangstone.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Vik. socialhandledare, Tallbacken
jobs.description: Hos oss möter du barn, ungdomar och vuxna i olika livssituationer. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa trygghet, skydd och en fungerande vardag för dem som bor hos oss.Tallbacken är ett kombinerat barn- och ungdomshem enligt barnskyddslagen och ett skyddshem för våldsutsatta personer och deras barn. Vi tar emot klienter från hela Åland och erbjuder stöd och omsorg utifrån deras behov och situation.Vi söker dig som är intresserad av ett omväxlande arbete där du möter människor i olika skeden av livet och med olika behov av stöd. Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt, är trygg i mötet med människor i utsatta situationer och kan ta egna initiativ. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och som en del av arbetsgruppen.Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och hemlik miljö med struktur och omsorg för barn, ungdomar och vuxna i utsatta livssituationer.Som person ser vi att du är ansvarstagande, flexibel, utåtriktad, gillar utmaningar samt har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift. Du behöver ha lätt för att ta initiativ i kontakten med både klienter, anhöriga samt aktivt samverka med interna och externa samarbetspartner. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Behörighetskravet är för uppgiften är lämplig högskoleexamen inom det sociala området i enlighet med 1 § landskapsförordning (2015:118) om skyddshemspersonal. För arbetet behövs körkort och straffregisterutdrag uppvisas innan anställning.Som stöd i ditt arbete håller vi regelbundna gemensamma arbetsgruppsmöten och erbjuder även extern handledning i grupp. Vår företagshälsovård inkluderar sjukvård på allmänläkarnivå och i friskvårdförmåner ingår massage, kultur och motion.Vikariatets omfattning är 80 %, men det finns goda möjligheter att utöka arbetstiden till 100 % under större delen av anställningstiden. Arbetet är i periodarbete och inleds 25.11.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 80% av 3 255,24 euro vid formell behörighet, samt eventuella erfarenhetstillägg. Prövotid tillämpas och intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
  • Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
  • Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
  • Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions)
  • Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
You have:
  • A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems
  • Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects
  • Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
  • A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: MHPSS Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.
