jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
jobs.description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

  1. A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

  2. Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

  3. Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

  4. Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

  5. A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview. 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process. 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students. 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  • Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis:

DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

jobs.description:

Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

  • Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

  • Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, APAC
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates residing in Australia or Singapore only. You can work from anywhere within those countries. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through a variety of communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

 - Deliver high-touch Enterprise support at scale, navigating complex account needs alongside Customer Success and Sales

Requirements

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Currently based in Australia or Singapore.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

We love new challenges and care deeply about the quality of our work.

Role summary

We're looking for a Creative Producer to help bring Linear's creative work to life. You'll work closely with Linear's internal creative studio, the Magic team, to manage projects across brand, marketing, and product launches.

In this role, you'll help keep our creative team focused and moving forward. From managing incoming requests and coordinating projects to tracking timelines and aligning stakeholders, you'll make sure great ideas turn into great work that ship on time.

 - Manage creative projects from initial brief through production and delivery, keeping timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders aligned

 - Maintain clear project documentation, timelines, and status updates, ensuring everyone has visibility into ongoing work

 - Identify potential blockers early, resolve dependencies, and continuously improve how the creative team operates

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Role Overview

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

jobs.title: Growth Engineer, Startups & SMBs
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth engineer to help grow Notion’s Startups and SMB programs. You’ll work closely with our Ecosystem Growth Lead to help more businesses grow with Notion.

You can spot opportunities in the data and own the executing on the plan that follows. You’re comfortable getting into the tools yourself, moving quickly without sacrificing accuracy, and staying accountable for results.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Work with a small team that operates like a growth lab. Startups and SMBs are the proving ground for ideas that can change how Notion grows.

 - Build and launch new growth programs, from creator-led acquisition to AI-powered systems for testing new audiences and campaigns. Bring your own ideas and take responsibility for getting them off the ground.

 - Move quickly from a rough hypothesis to a live experiment. Write code for new in-product experiences and build alongside Storytelling, Product, and Engineering to get your work into customers’ hands.

 - Use SQL and customer research to find overlooked opportunities. Measure what changes customer behavior and revenue, and use the results to choose where to go next.

 - Turn the strongest experiments into programs other teams can run. Build the systems and playbooks for them to expand across Notion, then take on the next growth challenge.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years and a record of shipping growth or operations projects. You can explain what you personally built and what changed as a result.

 - Typescript, Full-stack, and Systems-thinking

 - Strong SQL and analytical judgment. You can work through messy data and distinguish a promising signal from a misleading result.

 - Hands-on experience building campaigns or automated workflows in tools such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.

 - The ability to take an ambiguous goal and execute on growth initiatives. You unblock yourself where possible and communicate clearly when you need another team’s help.

 - Experience with self-serve SaaS or startup and SMB customers is a plus. If you’ve done similar work but with a different title, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Automotive Technician
jobs.description:
2 positions · Troubleshooting · Test setups · New components · R&D

Do you enjoy figuring out why something does not work? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two technicians who want to troubleshoot electric vehicles and machines, set up test setups and take part when we develop and test new components. You do not need many years of experience. What matters most is that you are hands on, curious and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines such as dumpers and excavators. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

The job

You will join our technical team in R&D and work closely with engineers, software developers and mechanics. You will be where things are tested and tried out in practice. One day you are troubleshooting a van, the next you are helping build a test setup for a new component. The work is mainly based in Dragør, but tasks at other locations may occasionally come up.

Your tasks will include:

•       Troubleshoot electrical systems and wiring harnesses on vehicles and machines

•       Set up and maintain test setups, both on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Help test new components and get them installed and integrated

•       Use diagnostic tools and CAN logs to find faults

•       Support engineers and software developers with the hands on work during testing

•       Document faults, solutions and test results so the rest of the team can use them.

Is this you?

You may be newly qualified or have a few years of experience from a workshop or similar. We care more about your troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn than about how long you have been in the trade.

•       Trained as a car mechanic, mechatronics technician, truck mechanic, construction machinery mechanic, electrician or similar

•       Experience with electrical troubleshooting on vehicles or machines

•       Comfortable using a multimeter and diagnostic equipment

•       Hands on, systematic and good at keeping things organised

•       Curious and quick to learn new things

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you know some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN, SavvyCAN or similar

•       Electric or hybrid vehicles, or high voltage systems

•       A driving licence for larger vehicles.

What we offer

•       A varied job on many different vehicles and machines

•       The chance to learn a lot about electric vehicles, CAN and high voltage

•       Close collaboration with engineers and software developers, where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Access to test equipment and modern diagnostic tools

•       An informal team in a growing startup

•       Good facilities, shared lunch and easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Number of positions: 2

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: Mainly on site in Dragør, with some flexibility by agreement

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself and your troubleshooting experience to louie@ren-teq.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

 

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Denmark · www.ren-teq.com

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, France (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and French

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Developer Platform https://www.notion.com/product/dev engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion.


You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale.


This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

 - You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day.

 - You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions.

 - You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

 - Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

 - Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs

 - Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals

 - Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 – $200,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

You will be the senior technical voice for our most strategic accounts in the region â and the person who sets the standard for how great technical partnership looks at Yuno.

Day to day, you will lead a team of TAMs while staying close to the most complex customer challenges yourself. LATAM is one of the fastest-growing payment ecosystems in the world, with unique local nuances and high-stakes integrations. That environment rewards people who bring both precision and resilience â someone who can stay steady under pressure, push through hard problems, and come out the other side with better solutions and stronger customer relationships than before.

This role also sits at the heart of Yuno's cross-functional engine. You will work closely with Product, Development, Sales, and Partnerships teams, making sure customer insights translate into real improvements and that internal teams have the context they need to move fast. jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Hardware sense

The garden3d technology story

Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

  • Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
  • Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
  • Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
  • A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
  • A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
  • A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
  • An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
  • Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

jobs.title: Director of IT and Workplace
jobs.description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

  • Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

  • Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities

  • Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

  • Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

  • Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

  • Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

  • Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in IT, spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

  • 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

  • Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

  • Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

  • Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

  • Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience, with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

  • Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

  • Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

  • IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

  • Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was coâfounded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the worldâs leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Childrenâs, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts whoâve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building worldâchanging technologies â ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @hippocraticai.com email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Read Me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Scaling our real-time sync engine https://linear.app/blog/scaling-the-linear-sync-engine talk by our cofounder, Tuomas Artman, at Linear's 2023 offsite

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. Company Profile:

Our client was founded to provide high quality professional & personalized tax preparation, accounting and bookkeeping services for individuals, businesses, and non-profits at reasonable rates. The company is a very fast-growing medium-sized accounting firm, allowing them to better serve individual business needs while helping clients save time and money. They serve clients throughout the United States, where demand for highly skilled Philippines-based accounting professionals continues to grow rapidly.

The company has maintained a Philippines accounting team for approximately 5 years and has consistently expanded its PH headcount year after year. The current Philippines team is nearing 30 professionals, and as the business continues to grow, they anticipate further long-term investment and expansion of their Philippines team into the future.

Our clientâs core values are centered around family, long-term career positioning, and professional development. They are reliable and responsive to clientsâ U.S. tax and accounting needs as businesses and organizations evolve through various operational and financial changes.
